task_completion.description: Load the T4 Lysozyme structure (PDB: 2LZM) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '2LZM' or '2lzm' as a loaded object, and a protein structure is visible in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Select and highlight Isoleucine 3 and Cysteine 97 in stick representation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two specific residues (at positions 3 and 97) are rendered as sticks, distinct from the rest of the protein (usually shown as cartoon/ribbon).

task_completion.description: Measure the distance between the C-beta (CB) atoms of ILE 3 and CYS 97.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (dashed line) is visible between the sidechains of residues 3 and 97, with a distance label displayed in the viewport.

task_completion.description: Save the high-quality visualization to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows a 'png' or 'export' command targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/t4l_engineered_disulfide.png'.

task_completion.description: Write a geometric analysis report with specific residue names and the measured distance.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows the creation of 't4l_disulfide_report.txt' containing the text 'ILE 3', 'CYS 97', and a distance value around 4.6-4.7 Angstroms.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL GUI or command line rather than just creating files via terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window active with the structure being manipulated or commands being typed into the PyMOL internal console.

integrity.description: The distance was measured using PyMOL's measurement tools, not hardcoded.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL viewport shows the 'dist' object or measurement labels generated by the software, not just a text overlay.

integrity.description: The measurement is specifically between C-beta atoms, not Alpha-carbons or other atoms.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement line connects the first carbon atom of the sidechain (CB), not the backbone (CA) or the sulfur (SG) of the Cysteine.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 2LZM. The target residues are ILE 3 and CYS 97. The actual C-beta to C-beta (CB-CB) distance in the 2LZM structure is approximately 4.63 Angstroms. A distance between 4.2 and 4.8 Angstroms is generally considered favorable for disulfide engineering. The output image must be saved to ~/PyMOL_Data/images/t4l_engineered_disulfide.png and the report to ~/PyMOL_Data/t4l_disulfide_report.txt.
